summary: Defines a canonical text format for writing IPv6 addresses, because the flexible forms allowed by RFC 4291 caused problems for operators and users. Implementations should write this form but still accept any legal form. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: There are many ways to write the same address, like writing 1 or 01. This picks one standard way so everyone matches.

questions: how to write an ipv6 address
